card.name: Small words in research methods text
card.fires_on: Small linking words, punctuation or numbers inside science-report and lab-method passages, such as 'using', 'the', 'of' or '$'. They come where a study's methods, funding or materials are being described.

modes.label: Lab methods
modes.description: Linking words inside descriptions of how an experiment was carried out.
modes.example: Bulk collections were made<< using>> aspirators and paintbrushes from under

modes.label: Funding credits
modes.description: Punctuation or 'the' within credits naming a research funder.
modes.example: The framing camera project is funded by NASA,<< the>>

modes.label: Citation and cost numbers
modes.description: Dollar signs and digits in science news or reference lists.
modes.example: a price tag of<< $>>425 million a deal

card.writes: It pushes toward words for researchers and scientific work, and away from marketing and business words.
card.plain: It fires on small filler words in science papers and news, where a study's methods or funding are being described.
